newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: London gasoil drives SIMEX Brent prices.
newsitem.headline: London gasoil drives SIMEX Brent prices.

text.p: September Brent futures on SIMEX were softer in late trading on Wednesday, as trading remained thin.
September Brent on SIMEX last traded at $19.50 per barrel, down two cents from London's close of $19.52.
But there was limited activity with only 51 lots traded.
Brokers in Singapore said the softer Brent was also the result of a smaller than expected rise in London gasoil price.
Gasoil on IPE traded 75 cents per tonne higher at $177, although the market had expected a rise of around $1.50 per tonne, brokers said
But they added that the market was watching the situation in the Middle East, especially between Israel and Palestine.
"Any sign of trouble there will definitedly push Brent prices up" said a broker.
On NYMEX, September crudes last traded at $20.80, a marginal fall of one cent from New York.
